dashboard_line: COC arch design done: 0x canonical, 4x shim, 8x deleted, 4 migrations W2
key_findings: 4x_coc_writer.py is MORE capable than 0x_coc_writer.py (has fcntl locking, HMAC chains, Ed25519, branch support) — migration requires porting features INTO 0x first, then shimming 4x
4x_coc_bridge.py is NOT a redundant COC writer — it is a pure hash utility (stamp/verify); classified incorrectly in Phase 1 as redundant; keep it with scope annotation
8x_protect_coc_paths.py and 4x_protect_coc_paths.py are identical in body — safe to delete 8x immediately
5x_vault_mutation_tracker.py, 5x_post_vault_write_stamp.py, 8x_droplet_coc_tracker.py all do direct open().write() to forensic JSONLs — 3 concrete migration targets for W2
5d_ann_coc_watcher.py has no retry logic on rclone upload — silent failure risk confirmed
4x_subagent_coc_collector.py is NOT a duplicate — serves distinct subagent trace collection function
eval-history.jsonl in 3x_eval_harness.py has its own hash chain (acceptable domain separation)
corrections_to_phase_1: 4x_coc_bridge.py should be KEEP+ANNOTATE, not DELETE — it is a hash utility, not a COC writer
4x_coc_writer.py features must be PORTED to 0x before shimming, not simply replaced — implementation order in Phase 1 design was inverted
4x_subagent_coc_collector.py is a distinct tool, not a duplicate of any other script

W1: Port fcntl locking + HMAC chain + branch support from 4x into 0x
Add error handling (retry, circuit breaker, rate limiter, fallback) to 0x
W2: Migrate 5d_ann_coc_watcher.py to log_annotation() + add retry loop

prescan_decision: passed — no existing design artifact for phase-2 found

emergence_notes.positive: Consolidated writer enables per-script traceability via agent_id+task_id; new log_vault_mutation() surfaces vault mutation rate analytics that are currently invisible
emergence_notes.uncertain: manifest_truthfulness improvement is unconfirmed — measure pre/post in W4 before claiming
emergence_notes.correction: Phase 1 misclassified 4x_coc_bridge.py as redundant; this correction prevents an unnecessary deletion that would break hash stamping in vault scripts

sign_off.session_note: Direct codebase inspection of all key scripts; corrections to Phase 1 manifest classification are load-bearing for correct implementation
